description: This file defines the StringUtils utility class providing static methods for string manipulation such as case-insensitive comparison, substring search, and method name extraction from dotted notation.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for string transformations and comparisons, especially case-insensitive operations and method name parsing.

methods.name: string toLower(const string & input)
methods.description: Converts an input string to lowercase.

methods.name: bool rfindInsensitive(const string & reference,const string & key)
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive check if 'key' is present at the end of 'reference'.

methods.name: bool checkStartsWithCaseInsensitive(const string & method,const string & key)
methods.description: Checks if 'method' starts with 'key', ignoring case.

methods.name: string extractMethodName(const string & method)
methods.description: Extracts and returns the method name after the last dot in the given string, converted to lowercase. Logs an error if the input format is invalid.

ctags.name: checkStartsWithCaseInsensitive
ctags.pattern: /^    static bool checkStartsWithCaseInsensitive(const string& method, const string& key) {$/

ctags.name: rfindInsensitive
ctags.pattern: /^    static bool rfindInsensitive(const string& reference, const string& key) {$/
